posts.title: Why Data Scientists Keep Saying Not To Use Prophet
posts.description: I tested Prophet against seasonal naive and ETS on two monthly series to see why a clean forecast chart is not enough to trust the model.

posts.title: Churn Prediction Is Easy. Reducing E-Commerce Churn Is Hard.
posts.description: How to reduce e-commerce churn after building a churn prediction model. A quick and raw look at retention workflows, customer context, discounts, and what happens after the churn score.

posts.title: ARIMA Is Boring, and That Is Why I Still Like It
posts.description: ARIMA is old, limited, and a little annoying. I still like it because it makes the assumptions and uncertainty in a forecast harder to ignore.
